summary: Frontend regression testing after expo 57.0.21 and expo-router 57.0.20 patch bump. All requested flows verified end-to-end on Expo web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). App loads, header/title/saved pill render, manual tone chips (warm/neutral/cool) all yield analysis-result with score+category badge, three color sections render (best/good/less), save look flips to Saved with toast + saved-pill increment, saved-looks modal lists entry, loading saved entry restores state. Zero console errors/warnings from the upgrade.
critical_code_review_comments: Reset button is only rendered when an imageSource exists; after loading a manual-tone saved look (no image) or after selecting a tone chip without an image, the reset control is not surfaced. Users can only 'start over' by switching tone chips in this state. Not a regression from the version bump — pre-existing behavior — but worth confirming this matches product intent.
seed_data_creation: None. Test only used AsyncStorage-backed saved look created in-session (1 entry: 'Cool rose').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend regression after expo/expo-router patch bump passed with no console errors. Verified flows: app load, header, tone chips (warm=96%, neutral=94%, cool=95%), 3 result sections, save look toggle + toast + pill increment, saved-looks modal listing + reopening entry (restores Saved state). Reset button only appears when an image is present (design decision).
